name: DEBUG EPR (UHF/STO-3G, 1 core)
template:
# DEBUG EPR -- tiny UHF/STO-3G g-tensor + hyperfine on 1 core, for testing the
# pipeline mechanics for free (the numbers are meaningless). The molecule must be
# an open-shell radical (set its multiplicity). Coords go before the eprnmr block.

! UHF STO-3G TightSCF

%maxcore 1000

%pal nprocs 1
end

!!##COORDS_SEC##!!

%eprnmr
  gtensor 1
  Nuclei = all { aiso, adip }
end
